newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- China successfully launches meteorological satellite from Xichang Satellite Launching Centre aboard Long March 3 rocket.
- Premier Li Peng tells visiting Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov that China attaches importance to relations with Macedonia.
- Pu Haiqing elected as first mayor of Chongqing
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Premier Li Peng tells Oman visitors that Chinese government supports its companies in increasing cooperation with Omani business concerns
- Xinhua news agency says that with the approach of Hong Kong's return to the motherland on July 1, the hearts of all Chinese people are full of patriotic feelings.
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- Storm and landslide in Yunnan province on June 4 kill 34 and injure 281 people
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Central bank governor Dai Xianglong says bank will provide assistance to Hong Kong Monetary Authority if needed after July 1 handover
- China Construction Bank reforms appraisal system for loans to boost efficiency and credit control
- PICC pays 1.25 million yuan compensation to flood-hit city of Jingmen in central Hubei province
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- State Development Bank allocates 49.5 billion yuan in loans to China's central and western regions in January-May period, accounting for 60 percent of total credit in period
BEIJING ECONOMIC DAILY
- Guangdong province seizes 34 million yuan worth of fake yuan in January-May, more than total found in 1996
CHINA CHEMICAL INDUSTRY NEWS
- China produced 19.92 million tyres in first four months, up 5.84 percent from year-ago period
CHINA DAILY
- Some 20,000 foreign and domestic business people gathered at Asia-Pacific trade fair in Yantai city and fair nets $4.3 million in contractual agreements.
- China's industrial sector achieves industrial ouput up by 11.9 percent in May from same month last year.
